#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <queue>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = LLONG_MAX;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    ll cap, cost;
    Edge(int to, int rev, ll cap, ll cost) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), cost(cost) {}
};

class Graph {
public:
    int V;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    Graph(int V) : V(V), adj(V) {}
    void addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, ll cost, ll cap) {
        adj[from].push_back(Edge(to, adj[to].size(), cap, cost));
        adj[to].push_back(Edge(from, adj[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }
};

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    Graph& g;
    int s, t;
    vector<ll> potential, dist;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;
    MinCostFlow(Graph& g, int s, int t, bool hasNegative) : g(g), s(s), t(t) {
        int V = g.V;
        potential.assign(V, INF);
        dist.assign(V, INF);
        prevv.resize(V);
        preve.resize(V);
        if (hasNegative) {
            // Bellman-Ford
            potential[s] = 0;
            bool updated;
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                updated = false;
                for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
                    if (potential[v] == INF) continue;
                    for (int j = 0; j < (int)g.adj[v].size(); j++) {
                        Edge& e = g.adj[v][j];
                        if (e.cap > 0 && potential[e.to] > potential[v] + e.cost) {
                            potential[e.to] = potential[v] + e.cost;
                            updated = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) break;
            }
        }
    }
    pair<ll, ll> minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(INF);
    }
    pair<ll, ll> minCostMaxFlow(ll maxf) {
        ll flow = 0, cost = 0;
        int V = g.V;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, greater<pair<ll, int>>> pq;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                ll d = p.first;
                int v = p.second;
                if (dist[v] < d) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g.adj[v].size(); i++) {
                    Edge& e = g.adj[v][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0) {
                        ll nd = d + e.cost + potential[v] - potential[e.to];
                        if (dist[e.to] > nd) {
                            dist[e.to] = nd;
                            prevv[e.to] = v;
                            preve[e.to] = i;
                            pq.push({nd, e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            for (int v = 0; v < V; v++) {
                if (dist[v] < INF) potential[v] += dist[v];
            }
            ll add = maxf - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                add = min(add, g.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            }
            flow += add;
            cost += add * potential[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge& e = g.adj[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= add;
                g.adj[e.to][e.rev].cap += add;
            }
        }
        return {cost, flow};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    string s;
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    {
        istringstream iss(line);
        iss >> n;
    }
    getline(cin, s);
    getline(cin, line);
    vector<int> a(n);
    {
        istringstream iss(line);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) iss >> a[i];
    }
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (char c : s) cnt[c - 'a']++;

    int pairCount = (n + 1) / 2;
    int V = n + 26 + 2;
    int source = V - 2;
    int sink = V - 1;
    Graph g(V);
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; j++) {
            int left = j;
            int right = n - 1 - j;
            ll w = 0;
            if (s[left] == s[right]) {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) {
                    w = -max(a[left], a[right]);
                }
            } else {
                if (s[left] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[left];
                if (s[right] == (char)('a' + i)) w -= a[right];
            }
            g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
        }
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < pairCount; j++) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(j, sink, 0, 2);
    }
    MinCostFlow mcmf(g, source, sink, true);
    ll cost = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow().first;
    cout << -cost << "\n";
    return 0;
}
